name: Customer Support Zone
shortSummary: A smart ticket management system that streamlines customer support and issue tracking efficiently.
description:
Providing the best system to manage customers ticketing efficiently, allowing support teams to track, update, and resolve tickets seamlessly with an intuitive interface.

Enjoy a simple, elegant dashboard, quick response tools, and smart filters that make customer management faster and easier than ever before. Designed with a focus on performance, usability, and responsiveness, it adapts beautifully to all devices and screen sizes.
features: View all active support tickets
Track in-progress and resolved tickets
Smart status-based filtering
Responsive layout with Tailwind grid

name: GameHub
shortSummary: A modern platform for discovering top games with Firebase Authentication and Framer Motion animations.
description: GameHub is a fully responsive web platform designed for gaming enthusiasts. Built with React and Firebase Auth, it offers a sleek UI with dynamic animations powered by Motion (Framer Motion). Game data is served locally from a static JSON file to provide quick loading times.
features: Email and password sign-in using Firebase Authentication
Google Sign-In for easier authentication
Protected routes using React Private Route
Interactive animations using Motion (Framer Motion)

name: AppoVate Software
shortSummary: An optimized App Store experience featuring custom Daisy UI components and persistent data handling.
description: Appovate delivers a high-performance app discovery platform. The project showcases advanced frontend patterns like live search filtering and installation simulation. By customizing Daisy UI and Tailwind, the application achieves a unique, store-like aesthetic while maintaining high accessibility and performance standards.
features: Customized Daisy UI components for a unique store-like experience
Persistent data logic using LocalStorage for installation tracking
In-depth app detail pages with real-time installation notifications
Optimized live search and download-based popularity sorting
Full-stack architecture with a dedicated Express/MongoDB API
Mobile-first responsive design principles

name: Bite Share
shortSummary: A secure MERN food-sharing platform featuring JWT-based API protection and full CRUD capabilities.
description: Bite Share is a community-driven application focused on reducing food waste. Built on the MERN stack, it handles complex user interactions including food requests, status updates, and inventory management. Security is a priority, utilizing Firebase for client-side auth and JWT-based middleware to protect backend RESTful APIs.
features: Secure JWT-based middleware for API protection
Full CRUD operations for managing food listings and requests
Real-time search and quantity-based sorting (Top Available Foods)
Request lifecycle management (Approval/Rejection logic)
Responsive UI optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop
Social and Email authentication via Firebase
